details: Former U.S. President Donald Trump suggested using inflation to rapidly pay off the nation's $40 trillion debt. This strategy, previously alluded to by JPMorgan analysts, involves driving higher nominal growth and inflation, which could significantly increase the value of assets like Bitcoin as a hedge against currency debasement.
title: Trump's $40 Trillion Debt Plan May Explode Bitcoin Price

details: Brent crude oil prices have exceeded $100 per barrel, driven by intensifying global geopolitical tensions, including reports of an Iranian strike on an oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. Despite these rising energy costs and associated recession concerns, capital inflows into the crypto space have continued, with Bitcoin demonstrating resilience and being increasingly viewed as an inflation-hedging asset.
title: Oil Surpasses $100, Bitcoin Acts as Inflation Hedge Amid Geopolitical Tensions

details: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) has warned that widespread adoption and expansion of stablecoins could undermine the effectiveness of traditional monetary policy. SNB Governing Board member Petra Tschudin stated that if funds shift from commercial banks to stablecoins, it could reduce the central bank's ability to influence borrowing costs and control financial conditions.
title: Swiss National Bank Expresses Concern Over Stablecoin Impact on Monetary Policy

details: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governor Sanjay Malhotra reiterated India's cautious stance on cryptocurrencies, citing concerns over monetary sovereignty, monetary policy implications, and capital flows, particularly for emerging markets. However, Malhotra confirmed India's support for the underlying technologies like distributed ledger technology (DLT) and tokenization, exploring their use for cross-border payments.
title: RBI Governor Cautions on Cryptocurrencies, Supports Underlying DLT

details: Gold prices declined sharply this week, pushing Wall Street towards a bearish majority, influenced by rising Treasury yields, a stronger U.S. dollar, and renewed Federal Reserve rate-hike expectations. Despite weaker U.S. jobs data, concerns remain regarding persistent inflation, high oil prices due to U.S.-Iran tensions, and broader geopolitical risks, contributing to market volatility. This macro environment creates headwinds for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: Wall Street Nears Bearish Majority as Gold Slides Amid Macro Headwinds
